text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
This year, North Flight enters the Senior 
year, ready to take on the sprint route in 
earnest. So, keeping New Year's greetings 
brief—

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, could you please hand me that 
magazine over there?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Dividing the work between them, they 
absorbed a wealth of information about the 
race.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The magazine North Flight was reading had 
'New Year Special Issue' on the cover. It 
seems to be featuring the Umamusume that 
are trending right now.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Of course! Please, have a seat next to me.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
First, about last year's Classic Triple 
Crown route. Ticket-san, Taishin-san, and 
Hayahide-san— the three BNWs—were very 
popular, weren't they?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"BNW... an acronym formed from the first 
letters of their names. They energized the 
Classic Triple Crown campaign with their 
fierce rivalry."

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
The three of them competed and pushed each 
other... putting on a magnificent race.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
"As for the Tiara route... hehe, there's a 
mention of me too! 'The Late-Blooming 
Speed Queen Blossoms,' it says!"

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Yukino-chan, and Harp Alpha-san too. 
...Competing against such dazzling people 
was truly so much fun.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: And—

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
"All eyes are on the absolute ruler Sakura 
Bakushin O in this year's sprint division. 
Will her undisputed reign continue with no 
rivals in sight?"

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: ...No rivals, huh?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"In terms of sheer ability, she is 
becoming an equal. Before long, the 
spectators and everyone around will 
realize it too."
choice_data_list:
Let's show them what we've got at the 
Takamatsunomiya Kinen!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: ...Yes!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Alright! Let's take a short break. It's 
New Year's, so why don't we go visit a 
shrine?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Ah!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Ah.

text_block_list.name: Flight & Bakushin
text_block_list.text: Happy New Year!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: "Wow, what an amazing coincidence!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
"I was actually just wishing for that from 
God a moment ago!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
"I want to run together with Flight-san 
even more... is what I want to say!"

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Is that... because we're friends?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: No. —Because we are rivals!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
When I heard you were entering the 
Takamatsunomiya Kinen, I got so excited!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: A class rep's intuition is 1200% accurate!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
It seems the one standing in my path... is 
you!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Thank you. I'm so happy... Bakushin 
O-chan.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
I've always wanted to run with you too. 
—As your rival.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I'm feeling overwhelmingly Bakushin right 
now!! Farewell, Flight-san――see you 
later!!
choice_data_list: ...She's always like a storm, isn't she.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
That's just how Bakushin O-chan is. 
...Hehe.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Now that we've finished our Hatsumode 
visit... What should we do next?
choice_data_list: Try learning how to put on a kimono

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Ah, it's already that time, isn't it.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
In that case, I know a café with a lovely 
atmosphere♪

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
—Hey, this place... has a wonderful 
atmosphere, don't you think?
choice_data_list: Yeah, it really calms you down.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Right! My recommended lunch set is—

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Oh! Flight-san, hello!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Entering the shop was Lois and Lois. An 
Umamusume from the same generation as 
North Flight, she boasts quite a 
respectable record.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"You came at just the right time! There's 
something I'd like to consult you about!"

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
"If you're fine with me! What's the 
matter?"

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
I'm holding my first fan meeting of the 
new year soon... but I'm having trouble 
deciding on an outfit theme.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
One, a proper kimono! Lady Royce, leveled 
up in elegance!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
And in an arranged traditional Japanese 
outfit! A leveled-up, super-cute 
Royce-chan!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Which one do you think would strike deeper 
into the fans' hearts?

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
I see~... I might want to solidify a 
clearer image before making up my mind.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Um, the image for the kimono is—

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Lady Royce with elevated grace!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Elevating grace... I see. So that's why 
the styled traditional attire is—

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Royce-chan with an extra dose of cute!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
"Amping up the cuteness... I see. Hm, 
hm..."
choice_data_list:
Flight... wait, are you getting reeled in 
or something?

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: ...Heh.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, in a way that somehow felt very 
Royce and Royce... we spent a relaxed New 
Year's Day.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
"You're right. Bakushin O-chan is giving 
it her all too, after all..."

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
I'm starting to get fired up too! Shall we 
head back to the academy?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Because of New Year's, the academy grounds 
were quiet... Yet out on the track, 
someone was already there.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Hup... ho...

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Nice, feeling light as a feather.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She is Jungle Pocket. An Umamusume in the 
same grade as North Flight, and a bit on 
the mischievous side.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Pokke-chan! Happy New Year!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Oh, Flight! Happy New Year~.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: You're so dedicated, even on New Year's.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah. I've just been feeling super great 
since this morning~."

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Right now—even against you, I might just 
be able to keep up!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Heard you're doing crazy good right now. 
How about it, let's go for one race... 
right now!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Jungle Pocket hasn't even debuted yet. 
Snapping at North Flight, who's already 
proven herself... she's certainly got some 
serious nerve.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
"That's... an invitation to run together, 
isn't it? Hmm, I wonder."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And Flight is also— an undaunted Umamusume 
with an unyielding core.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
I expect I will keep you waiting quite a 
while. I always make it a point to warm up 
thoroughly and meticulously.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Besides—running with me doesn't feel like 
the best coordination for you, 
Pocket-chan.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: "...―― You really are strong, aren't you."

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"N-No, sorry for dropping in so suddenly! 
—Next time, I'll be sure to wear my racing 
Racewear properly."

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. I can't wait to see Pokke-chan's 
racing silks.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, under Jungle Pocket's watchful 
gaze... we proceeded with training at a 
Bakushin pace.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Looking around the shrine grounds, many 
people were wearing kimonos. I've always 
admired it as a traditional New Year look, 
so I decided to seize the moment and try 
something new."
choice_data_list: You can do kimono dressing, right, Flight?

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Yes! But returning to the basics once more 
sounds like a good idea too.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
In that case... let's call in some help 
and learn how to put on a kimono properly, 
shall we? ♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the helper North Flight called in 
was Air Groove, an Umamusume who excels in 
both literary and athletic pursuits.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Apparently, Air Groove has also been 
learning how to dress in kimono as part of 
her personal refinement—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
To prevent dust and lint from getting on 
the kimono, we use an Ishoshiki mat like 
this.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
"People tend to simplify it, but it's an 
important step. And then—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At first, the kimono dressing class was 
proceeding smoothly, quickly, and clearly 
under the two instructors, but...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In truth, at the stage of putting the 
garments on over my clothes—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Flight, pass me the obi. The green one 
over there.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Oh, if it's for the kimono you're wearing 
right now... Wouldn't that crimson one 
over there look lovely as well?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...No, it has patterns on it, it's too 
flashy. Green really is the way to go.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Since New Year's is a festive occasion, I 
believe a slightly brighter splash of 
color would be appropriate.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
"Or, if it has to be the same green 
color... Ah, what about that geometric 
pattern one?"

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Mm, true... No, wait, if that's the case, 
let's explore similar colors a bit more—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And with support from the two of them, she 
managed to finish dressing herself.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: It's perfect! You're wonderful, Trainer♪

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
"Changing the color tone really was the 
right move. It gives off such a 
sophisticated look♪"

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... I see. So this is what happens when 
you interpret it with greater freedom.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Now then, next please set it to that one!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, what was supposed to just be a 
kimono-dressing lesson... ended up turning 
into a mini fashion show.
